analysis.detail: GnuPG binary package. GnuPG is installed for build-time package signature verification only; not invoked at runtime by Liquibase.

vulnerabilities.description: GnuPG can be made to spin on a relatively small input by (for example) crafting a public key with thousands of signatures attached, compressed down to just a few KB.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: No action required. GnuPG is not invoked at container runtime.

ratings.justification: No gpg/gnupg/dirmngr invocation exists anywhere in this image's runtime.

analysis.detail: GnuPG can be made to spin/consume excessive CPU on a relatively small input, such as a crafted public key with thousands of signatures compressed into a few KB (explicit upstream won't-fix). No gpg/gnupg/dirmngr invocation exists anywhere in this image's runtime.
